# Rajveer Singh Pall

> Machine-learning researcher and engineer. This site covers the systems: local-first agents, retrieval, fairness tooling and research pipelines. The papers live on the research site, which is the canonical source for their status and numbers.

Statuses are stated exactly and never upgraded. Papers under double-blind review do not name their venue.

## Systems

- [ARIA Assistant](https://rajveer-code.github.io/project-aria.html): Local-first voice agent: 16 tools, 7.1 GB VRAM, no cloud LLM calls.
- [IndiaFinBench](https://rajveer-code.github.io/project-indiafinbench.html): 406 expert-annotated questions over SEBI and RBI regulation, with a hybrid BM25 and FAISS retrieval stack.
- [fairscope](https://rajveer-code.github.io/project-fairscope.html): Subgroup-stratified, calibration-aware fairness auditing on PyPI.
- [FinSight](https://rajveer-code.github.io/project-finsight.html): Earnings-intelligence pipeline over 14,584 transcripts from 601 S&P 500 firms.
- [FinSight + Web](https://rajveer-code.github.io/project-finsight-web.html): A scroll-driven WebGL monograph of the FinSight findings.
- [SereneSpace](https://rajveer-code.github.io/project-serenespace.html): Anonymous student mental-health platform, top 50 of 250 at Smart India Hackathon 2025.

## Papers and manuscripts

- [Benchmark Accuracy Is Not an Identified Quantity](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/benchmark-accuracy-not-identified/): Under review. Most orderings on a published MATH-Hard leaderboard cannot be separated once the responses a scorer could not read are counted.
- [Higher AUC, Fewer Cases Flagged: Subgroup Fairness Metrics Can Reverse at the Decision Threshold in Federated Diabetes Screening](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/subgroup-fairness-reversal/): Under review. Federated training narrows the White-Black AUC gap while a race-blind screening policy flags fewer Black respondents.
- [Benchmarks Do Not Report Whether They Could Read the Answer](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/could-it-read-the-answer/): Under review. Two answer extractors shipped in the same evaluation harness disagree by 88.5 points on the same 400 MMLU responses.
- [Scoring-Rule Sensitivity in LLM Evaluation: Evidence from Indian Financial Regulatory Text](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/indiafinbench/): Under review. Changing only the scoring rule reorders twelve LLMs on a new Indian financial-regulation benchmark, and no model keeps its rank.
- [Comprehensive Evaluation of Machine Learning for Type 2 Diabetes Risk Prediction: Large-Scale External Validation and Fairness Analysis](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/diabetes-external-validation/): IEEE Xplore (CIPHER-2026) · Published. Internally validated diabetes models lose discrimination on 1.28M external records, and adults over 60 lose the most.
- [TrustShift: A Mechanism-Aware Audit of Machine-Learning Deployment Shift](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/trustshift/): Manuscript. Across four real deployment shifts, shift magnitude alone does not consistently explain which trustworthiness axis fails.
- [Confidently Wrong: Ranking Inversion in Cross-Network Denial-of-Service Detection](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/confidently-wrong/): Manuscript. On a new network, DoS detectors do not decay toward chance: many pass through it and score attacks below benign traffic.
- [Scorer-Induced Partial Identification of Benchmark Comparisons: An Audit-Design Approach](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/scorer-partial-identification/): In preparation. Once a scorer’s error rate is audited rather than assumed, audit uncertainty outweighs sampling uncertainty in all 120 well-defined comparisons.
- [Persistent Racial Disparities in U.S. Mortgage Approval: Evidence from 42 Million Applications, 2020-2024](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/mortgage-disparities/): Journal of Housing Economics · Under review. The public-data Black-White mortgage approval gap at national scale: how large, where it lives, and how it responds to institutional boundaries.
- [Who Bears the Burden? Heterogeneous Racial Approval Differentials in U.S. Mortgage Lending: Causal Forest DML on 42 Million HMDA Applications](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/who-bears-the-burden/): SSRN · Working paper. Not whether an average penalty exists, but who bears it, and through which underwriting channel.
- [When the Gate Stays Closed: Empirical Evidence of Near-Zero Cross-Sectional Predictability in Large-Cap NASDAQ Equities Using an IC-Gated Machine Learning Framework](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/when-the-gate-stays-closed/): SSRN · Working paper. A deployment gate for financial ML, and the discipline to report that it stayed closed.
- [Text Genre, Not Platform Identity, Predicts Transfer Failure in Mental Health Natural Language Processing: A Five-Axis Deployment Audit Across Five Corpora](https://rajveer-research.vercel.app/research/text-genre-transfer-failure/): Manuscript. A five-axis pre-deployment audit of mental-health text classifiers moved across platforms and corpora.
